contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ D[N VA]LEN[---] ; R/ SECVRITAS REIPVBLICAE

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of House of Valentinian (364-378), Securitas Reipublicae issue of 364-378, possibly Trier mint, Reece period 19. Obverse description: Diademed draped and cuirassed bust right. Obverse inscription: D[N VA]LEN[---]. Reverse description: Victory advancing left holding wreath. Reverse inscription: SECVRITAS REIPVBLICAE. In field: O ?F. In exergue: possibly TRP, indistinct. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 18.3mm, Weight: 1.52gms, die axis: 12
